questions.question: What does the psalmist ask God to send out?
Where does the psalmist long to go?
options: To the throne of the king, his certain hope
To the field of his fathers, his lasting home
To the altar of God, his exceeding joy
To the gate of the city, his place of refuge
questions.answer: To the altar of God, his exceeding joy
